recommendations.name: test-suite-stop-gate
recommendations.best_for: Block turn end while the project test suite fails — failures feed back (exit 2 + stderr) so the agent fixes before finishing
recommendations.value: Turn-level green gate. Complements the per-edit related-test hooks (jest/pytest/vitest-related) without paying full-suite latency on every edit. Recipe requirements: (1) exit 0 when stop_hook_active is true — prevents infinite fix-loops; (2) skip when the working tree is clean (pure Q&A turns); (3) cache a green-run hash of the diff so an unchanged tree never re-runs the suite; (4) measure suite runtime first — wire only when the full run stays under ~60s, otherwise gate a scoped subset.

recommendations.name: pre-write-gate
recommendations.best_for: Projects whose CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md carry pre-implementation rules (minimum-code, surgical-scope, push-back-before-coding) that get skipped when the agent jumps straight to editing
recommendations.value: Fires before every Edit/Write and surfaces the 4-principle pre-write checklist (state assumptions · minimum code · surgical scope · verifiable goal) as non-blocking additionalContext — an enforcement layer that holds regardless of which skill is active. Closes the gap where auto-loaded CLAUDE.md rules are present but never gated at edit time (#101).
